segments.name: Telecom
segments.description: Mexican telecom business selling cable, DTH satellite and enterprise services to residential, commercial and enterprise customers.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we classify our operations into one single business segment Telecom.

revenueModel.text: Residential and business subscribers pay monthly fees for cable, broadband, telephony and satellite television, and advertisers and enterprises pay for advertising and managed services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our cable companies generate revenues from their pay-TV, broadband, internet and telephony services, from additional services such as video on demand, and from sales of advertising to local and national advertisers.

changes.text: In the fourth quarter of 2025 the company combined its Cable and Sky businesses into the single Telecom reportable segment.
changes.evidence: Beginning in the fourth quarter of 2025, we present the operating results of our Cable and Sky businesses as a single reportable segment.

changes.text: The former Other Businesses segment ceased to be a segment after the 2024 spin-off of the Spun-off Businesses to Ollamani.
changes.evidence: As a result, we no longer own the Spun-off Businesses of our former Other Businesses segment, and, beginning with the first quarter of 2024, we began classifying the Spun-off Businesses as a discontinued operation and since then the Other Businesses segment is no longer a business segment.
